text:
{collection}.{field}: {type_id} has no rule version {rule}.
This version knows rule version {known} of every built-in type.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: a built-in field type names a rule version this core does not know. `known` is the one it knows. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
